what: The section head stays stuck to the screen (sticky, section height 200lvh) while a vertical video or photo strip in the center opens from the middle to both sides with clip-path. It is fully open within 70% of the stuck range, and after 30% the name letters rise from below in 40ms steps (1.6s quart). Scrolling back lowers them together in .6s.

options.length: Height of the section where the head sticks (lvh), default 200
options.open: Point where opening ends (ratio of the attached span), default .7
options.at: Point where the text rises (open ratio), default .3
options.--fx-rise-dur·--fx-rise-ease·--fx-fall-d: Letter rise and fall duration and curve (css)
options.[data-fx-part=film]: Strip that opens from the center (required)
options.[data-fx-part=title]: Heading whose letters rise (optional) — splits the text into word chunks

note: The body sliding up to cover the header (header set sticky, next body raised by z) and the dim overlay when covered are up to the user — the part only handles the opening and text inside the header

from.where: index.html .ar-serial__head (product name header — center 720px band video) · original serialsHead component
